changelog: Turn a finished video's comments into one pin comment still per original quote.

en.description: Turn a finished video's comments into one pin comment still per original quote. This pinned comment card studio reads public comments or pasted lines, then makes a comment screenshot for each seller-picked quote. Use it for pin comment cards, video comment cards, and quote cards that keep the original words.
en.summary: Turn a finished video's comments into one pin comment still per original quote.
en.title: Pin Comment Cards: Screenshot Stills of Original Quotes
